		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1061 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 1291 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 12144 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1062 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 7329 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 12199 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1063 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 7399 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1064 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 1376 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1065 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 13408 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1066 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 4401 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1067 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 4251 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 10467 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1068 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 1592 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 1563 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1069 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 10330 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1070 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 10234 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 4226 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1071 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 12120 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1072 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 13080 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1076 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 7408 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1077 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 10398 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 10221 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1078 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 12224 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 7225 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1079 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 3 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 4543 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 7887 } set_variable = { rn_vp_2 = 4718 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1080 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 1 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 12632 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { rn_sel_state_id = 1081 } } set_variable = { rn_vp_cnt = 2 } set_variable = { rn_vp_0 = 2211 } set_variable = { rn_vp_1 = 8241 } }
	}
}

# Apply the input buffer to the current target. meta_effect turns the scripted loc into a literal string,
# so the stored name is plain text. Persistence was observed in stage0 probes; MP still needs a two-client test.
rn_apply_input = {
	# Temporary city diagnostics: observe the target without changing Apply conditions.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 3 } }
		log = "Rename Anything city apply: player=[ROOT.GetTag] province=[?ROOT.rn_tprov|0] target_states=[?ROOT.rn_tstate^num|0] input_len=[?ROOT.rn_len|0] digits=[ROOT.RN_PD_0][ROOT.RN_PD_1][ROOT.RN_PD_2][ROOT.RN_PD_3][ROOT.RN_PD_4]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rn_len > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 1 } }
			# Rebuild the player's current characters; a target can transfer/retire while the input stays open.
			rn_refresh_lists = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = rn_tchar
				if = {
					limit = { is_in_array = { array = ROOT.rn_chars_all value = THIS } }
					meta_effect = {
						text = { set_character_name = "[N]" }
						N = "[ROOT.RN_B_0][ROOT.RN_B_1][ROOT.RN_B_2][ROOT.RN_B_3][ROOT.RN_B_4][ROOT.RN_B_5][ROOT.RN_B_6][ROOT.RN_B_7][ROOT.RN_B_8][ROOT.RN_B_9][ROOT.RN_B_10][ROOT.RN_B_11][ROOT.RN_B_12][ROOT.RN_B_13][ROOT.RN_B_14][ROOT.RN_B_15][ROOT.RN_B_16][ROOT.RN_B_17][ROOT.RN_B_18][ROOT.RN_B_19][ROOT.RN_B_20][ROOT.RN_B_21][ROOT.RN_B_22][ROOT.RN_B_23][ROOT.RN_B_24][ROOT.RN_B_25][ROOT.RN_B_26][ROOT.RN_B_27][ROOT.RN_B_28][ROOT.RN_B_29][ROOT.RN_B_30][ROOT.RN_B_31]"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 2 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = rn_tstate
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
					meta_effect = {
						text = { set_state_name = "[N]" }
						N = "[ROOT.RN_B_0][ROOT.RN_B_1][ROOT.RN_B_2][ROOT.RN_B_3][ROOT.RN_B_4][ROOT.RN_B_5][ROOT.RN_B_6][ROOT.RN_B_7][ROOT.RN_B_8][ROOT.RN_B_9][ROOT.RN_B_10][ROOT.RN_B_11][ROOT.RN_B_12][ROOT.RN_B_13][ROOT.RN_B_14][ROOT.RN_B_15][ROOT.RN_B_16][ROOT.RN_B_17][ROOT.RN_B_18][ROOT.RN_B_19][ROOT.RN_B_20][ROOT.RN_B_21][ROOT.RN_B_22][ROOT.RN_B_23][ROOT.RN_B_24][ROOT.RN_B_25][ROOT.RN_B_26][ROOT.RN_B_27][ROOT.RN_B_28][ROOT.RN_B_29][ROOT.RN_B_30][ROOT.RN_B_31]"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 3 } check_variable = { rn_tprov > 0 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = rn_tstate
				log = "Rename Anything city ownership check: player=[ROOT.GetTag] state=[THIS.GetName] owner=[THIS.Owner.GetTag] province=[?ROOT.rn_tprov|0] target_states=[?ROOT.rn_tstate^num|0]"
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
					log = "Rename Anything city owned target accepted: province=[?ROOT.rn_tprov|0] target_states=[?ROOT.rn_tstate^num|0]"
					meta_effect = {
						debug = yes
						text = { set_province_name = { id = [P] name = "[N]" } }
						P = "[ROOT.RN_PD_0][ROOT.RN_PD_1][ROOT.RN_PD_2][ROOT.RN_PD_3][ROOT.RN_PD_4]"
						N = "[ROOT.RN_B_0][ROOT.RN_B_1][ROOT.RN_B_2][ROOT.RN_B_3][ROOT.RN_B_4][ROOT.RN_B_5][ROOT.RN_B_6][ROOT.RN_B_7][ROOT.RN_B_8][ROOT.RN_B_9][ROOT.RN_B_10][ROOT.RN_B_11][ROOT.RN_B_12][ROOT.RN_B_13][ROOT.RN_B_14][ROOT.RN_B_15][ROOT.RN_B_16][ROOT.RN_B_17][ROOT.RN_B_18][ROOT.RN_B_19][ROOT.RN_B_20][ROOT.RN_B_21][ROOT.RN_B_22][ROOT.RN_B_23][ROOT.RN_B_24][ROOT.RN_B_25][ROOT.RN_B_26][ROOT.RN_B_27][ROOT.RN_B_28][ROOT.RN_B_29][ROOT.RN_B_30][ROOT.RN_B_31]"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 4 } }
			rn_store_country_name = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 5 } }
			rn_store_country_adj = yes
		}
	}
	rn_cancel_input = yes
}

# Reset a city (VP province) name by clearing the override. This also works for VPs without a loc key.
rn_reset_vp = { # temp rn_k = slot
	rn_target_vp = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rn_tprov > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = rn_tstate
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				meta_effect = {
					text = { reset_province_name = [P] }
					P = "[ROOT.RN_PD_0][ROOT.RN_PD_1][ROOT.RN_PD_2][ROOT.RN_PD_3][ROOT.RN_PD_4]"
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ============================================================== COUNTRY NAME - NATIVE RN1 PROTOCOL
# The cosmetic tag is the game's saved/synchronised carrier. The native plugin decodes both fields
# when looking up country localisation keys. Without it, the tag remains saved but display falls back
# to the original country name. Never treat rn_custom_name as proof that the plugin is active.
rn_apply_country_name = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			rn_country_rename_enabled = yes
			check_variable = { rn_cname_len > 0 }
			check_variable = { rn_cadj_len > 0 }
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { set_cosmetic_tag = "RN1|[N]|[J]|" }
			N = "[ROOT.RN_N_0][ROOT.RN_N_1][ROOT.RN_N_2][ROOT.RN_N_3][ROOT.RN_N_4][ROOT.RN_N_5][ROOT.RN_N_6][ROOT.RN_N_7][ROOT.RN_N_8][ROOT.RN_N_9][ROOT.RN_N_10][ROOT.RN_N_11][ROOT.RN_N_12][ROOT.RN_N_13][ROOT.RN_N_14][ROOT.RN_N_15][ROOT.RN_N_16][ROOT.RN_N_17][ROOT.RN_N_18][ROOT.RN_N_19][ROOT.RN_N_20][ROOT.RN_N_21][ROOT.RN_N_22][ROOT.RN_N_23][ROOT.RN_N_24][ROOT.RN_N_25][ROOT.RN_N_26][ROOT.RN_N_27][ROOT.RN_N_28][ROOT.RN_N_29][ROOT.RN_N_30][ROOT.RN_N_31]"
			J = "[ROOT.RN_J_0][ROOT.RN_J_1][ROOT.RN_J_2][ROOT.RN_J_3][ROOT.RN_J_4][ROOT.RN_J_5][ROOT.RN_J_6][ROOT.RN_J_7][ROOT.RN_J_8][ROOT.RN_J_9][ROOT.RN_J_10][ROOT.RN_J_11][ROOT.RN_J_12][ROOT.RN_J_13][ROOT.RN_J_14][ROOT.RN_J_15][ROOT.RN_J_16][ROOT.RN_J_17][ROOT.RN_J_18][ROOT.RN_J_19][ROOT.RN_J_20][ROOT.RN_J_21][ROOT.RN_J_22][ROOT.RN_J_23][ROOT.RN_J_24][ROOT.RN_J_25][ROOT.RN_J_26][ROOT.RN_J_27][ROOT.RN_J_28][ROOT.RN_J_29][ROOT.RN_J_30][ROOT.RN_J_31]"
		}
		set_country_flag = rn_custom_name
	}
}
# ============================================================== END COUNTRY NAME - NATIVE RN1 PROTOCOL
